answer.rationale: Verifying memory_b1 (day 18) to confirm the historical effectiveness and procedure of rolling back a release to clear an error spike. With p99 latency climbing 5x and a release 2 hours ago correlating with the regression, a rollback is the most surgical, customer-preserving move consistent with prior precedent. The other candidates (failover, capacity, breakers, replicas) either move customer writes off the healthy region or don't address the recent build regression directly. Verification budget is used to reconfirm rollback is the known-working lever before pulling the trigger.
